  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The symlink checks fail to detect when `.claude` itself is a symlink, allowing dry-run and live sync copy paths to write files through it into its target.
  WHY: A `.claude -> .git` symlink can cause template files to be written into `.git`, bypassing the documented symlink rejection; severity disagreed, with minimax_minimax-m3 and qwen_qwen3_7-plus rating it BLOCKER and deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro and z-ai_glm-5_2 rating it MAJOR.

- scripts/sync_claude_live_copies.py: mismatched() lines 109-116 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: The symlink check misses `.claude` itself because checking the `.` parent follows that symlink, so `mismatched()` and the copy paths can write through it instead of rejecting it.
  WHY: A `.claude` symlink pointing to `.git` can make dry-run or live sync write new template files into `.git`, despite the documented guarantee that live-path symlinks are rejected.

  PROBLEM: The dry-run copy path skips `mismatched()` and its symlink checks before creating directories and copying files through the live path.
